chain.label: POH for 690/690A/690B contains no spin recovery procedure
chain.trigger: The pilot operating handbook (POH) for the Twin Commander 690B does not include a procedure for recovering from an inadvertent spin (the 690 and 690A models also don't contain a procedure).

chain.label: Pilot lacked documented spin recovery technique for the model
chain.trigger: it is possible pilots could unintentionally enter a spin following a stall... pilots should have access to all pertinent information to promote safe flight (including spin recovery techniques)

caused_by.evidence: the inclusion of a spin recovery procedure in the Twin Commander Aircraft POHs for the 690, 690A, and 690B models might aid pilots in recovering from a spin

chain.label: Pilot allowed airspeed to decay while leveling at 16,100 ft on survey line
chain.trigger: the airplane's groundspeed decreased to about 93 knots, and the airplane descended about 500 ft while on a steady northeasterly heading

chain.label: Critical angle of attack exceeded; inadvertent stall
chain.trigger: the pilot's failure to maintain adequate airspeed, which caused the airplane to exceed its critical angle of attack and enter an inadvertent stall and spin

caused_by.evidence: failure to maintain adequate airspeed, which caused the airplane to exceed its critical angle of attack

chain.label: Unrecovered spin and rapid nose-low descent
chain.trigger: "Mayday, mayday, mayday" and "we're in a spin" transmissions were broadcast... spinning about its longitudinal axis

caused_by.evidence: enter an inadvertent stall and spin
impacted terrain following an inadvertent stall and spin from which the pilot did not recover

chain.label: Impact with wooded terrain in nose-low vertical attitude
chain.trigger: it impacted the ground in a nose-low vertical attitude and at a high rate of speed

caused_by.evidence: impacted wooded terrain near Hiles, Wisconsin, after entering an inadvertent stall and spin

chain.label: Pilot and two passengers fatally injured
chain.trigger: The pilot and two passengers sustained fatal injuries.

caused_by.evidence: impacted the ground in a nose-low vertical attitude and at a high rate of speed
